definitions: A long, narrow sheet of plastic that is placed on the ground, often on a slight incline, and made wet so that people can slide down it.
A children's toy consisting of a long plastic sheet that is made slippery with water, allowing users to slide along it.
examples: The kids loved playing on the slip and slide all afternoon.
We set up the slip and slide in the backyard.
A new slip and slide was purchased for the summer party.
